findings: Missing index-project.js: The companion CLI entrypoint src/ai/index-project.js referenced in the plan and README was never created. Running 'node src/ai/index-project.js /path/to/app' will fail with Cannot find module. Create a minimal JS wrapper that calls indexProject() from CodeIndexer and prints JSON.

Settings toggles don't affect running interceptors: SettingsTab calls AppLens.initialize(updated) on every Switch toggle, but initialize() skips interceptor management after the first call. Toggling network:false or console:false changes config but leaves the interceptors attached and still capturing. The UI provides false confidence the feature is disabled. Either expose detach()/attach() on the singleton, or document that toggles require an app restart.

useEffect initialization creates an early-boot blind spot: AppLens.initialize() in App.tsx is inside useEffect, so it fires after the first render. Module-level side effects (axios-provider import, Redux store hydration, Firebase init) run before this — any console output or network calls in that window are never captured. Move initialize() to module level with an if (__DEV__) guard.

Floating trigger z-index on Android (likely): AppLensTrigger uses position:'absolute', zIndex:9999 inside SafeAreaProvider. On Android, z-index does not cross View hierarchies, so navigation-level modals or elevated surfaces from RootNavigator may render above the trigger. Render the trigger as a direct child of the root View in App, outside SafeAreaProvider.
